doc: Preregistration for M6 iterations (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md §0.1, §4 "M6: generality"). One key per iteration under iterations, each in its own source spec/M6/predictions/<key>.json (holon.aggregate writes this aggregate from them). A key is written once, in its prereg commit, before any of its outcome_paths change; holon audit prereg checks the order and that the key is never edited afterwards. predictions count toward prediction accuracy; regressions are outcomes already recorded in the repo that must not change.

I105.title: I105: Go state machines: the Go frontend emits transitions documents in the Solidity frontend's IR (struct-field machines first, then constant-prefix KV stores), with writes it cannot model over-approximated as havoc, so the typed pipeline (sorts, types, model, disch, derive) runs unchanged on a Go-only machine

predictions.claim: On the planted fixture (tests_m6/fixtures/i105/src), holon extract go_machines writes one holon-facts/0.3 transitions document (extraction.kind transitions, frontend go) per machine, exactly the five struct types with exported methods (Bank, Alias, Loop, Spawn, Keeper); Bank's families are Bal (mapping), Count, Owner, Paused (scalars); its actions are its eight exported methods; Deposit writes Bal at [[map, [param, who]]] and Count from [storage, Count]; SetPaused writes Paused := [param, p] behind a guard over [param, caller] and [storage, Owner]; Withdraw's guards mention [storage, Paused] and [param, n]; Halt's panic is a guard over [storage, Paused]; the value receiver Credit writes the shared map Bal, Lose (a write to the receiver's copy) and Total write nothing, Total returns [storage, Count]; Tick writes Count through the inlined unexported helper.

Soundness on the planted cases: a write the frontend cannot model is never dropped. Through (a local alias of &a.X) writes X := [param, v] exactly; Leak (&a.Y passed to a dynamic call) writes Y with a havoc value (holding [unknown, ...]); Deref (a write through a pointer read from the state) writes every family (P, X, Y) with havoc values; Fill (writes inside a loop bounded by an argument) writes Arr and N with havoc values and records loop debt, and K := 7 after the loop exactly; Go (a goroutine writing X) writes X with a havoc value, records goroutine debt, and Z := 2 exactly.

The KV-store pattern: the planted Keeper (a field of an interface type with Get/Has/Set/Delete over []byte keys) has the mapping family store; its actions are Balance, Remove, SetBalance; SetBalance writes store at a map key that holds [param, addr] and the prefix constant [str, hex("bal/")], with a value that mentions [param, amt], behind a guard over [param, caller]; Remove deletes (writes 0) at that key behind a guard that reads [storage, store].

The typed pipeline runs unchanged on a Go-only machine: on the Bank document, I51's stages sorts, types, model, disch and derive (holon.eval.holon_run._rules, spec/M4/lib/i51_run.json) all finish ok and derive at least one law.
Two extractions of the planted fixture write the same file names with byte-identical contents.

Smoke measure on I51's Go entries at their prefix commits (results/M6/I105/corpus.json, python -m holon eval go-machines; machines counted over every Go document of the entry, actions summed over its machines): per entry, machines and actions lie in the preregistered ranges [machines_lo, machines_hi, actions_lo, actions_hi] of expected.

Smoke measure: the typed pipeline (sorts, types, model, disch, derive over the entry's transitions documents) completes on at least 1 of the 8 entries; on every other entry the first stage that is not ok is named in refused_at.
Smoke measure: the laws derived over the 8 entries total between 1 and 500.

regressions.claim: The Solidity frontend and the Go codec frontend are unchanged: every file of holon/frontends/solidity/ and holon/frontends/go/ (ssadump's main.go included) hashes to its pin, so every Solidity document and every Go codec document re-extracts byte-identically; the Go machine emitter lives in its own frontend module. Morph's M0-M3 records move by re-stamp only (holon land dirty, reported in docs/iterations/I105.md).

informed.why: no outcome of these claims is recorded anywhere before this prereg: no Go transitions document exists, and no corpus run of the emitter has been made (I51's results/eval/holon/ hold codec documents only)

thresholds.smoke: P6-P8 are smoke measures (the brief: I107 scores); a miss is reported, never tuned to

definitions.machine: a named struct type declared in a document package with at least one exported method (value or pointer receiver) declared in that package
definitions.action: an exported method of a machine declared in the package; its walk inlines static calls of functions of the document's packages to the config's inline_depth
definitions.complete: the stages sorts, types, model, disch and derive all finish with status ok over the entry's machine documents
definitions.laws: the L*.json files derive writes to laws/<milestone> for the entry
